description: This file defines the immutable data class GameState, representing the current state of a Tic-Tac-Toe game. It includes references to the game board, current player, winner, and draw status. The class is designed to be easily unit-testable and contains no Android-specific dependencies.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: Immutable snapshot of the current game state for Tic-Tac-Toe, holding information about the board, current player, winner, and draw status.

methods.name: GameState
methods.description: Primary constructor for GameState data class, initializing the board, currentPlayer, winner, and isDraw properties.
